targets_file.description: Path to file containing one target per line (use with -f; only allowed for root). If empty, use targets_list or stdin.

targets_list.description: List of targets (hostnames or IPs) to ping. Ignored if targets_file is set (since file usage is preferred for large lists).

options.description: List of command-line options (e.g., ['-a', '-q', '-g 192.168.1.0/24']). Each item must be a single shell token or quoted phrase safe for command-line injection.
